aimslowplus.screen.title: Aim Slow Plus
aimslowplus.button.reset.tooltip: Restore every setting to its default value.
aimslowplus.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When OFF, your mouse behaves exactly like vanilla.
aimslowplus.option.strength.tooltip: How much the mouse slows down when your crosshair is right on a target. 0% = no effect.
aimslowplus.option.bubble.tooltip: Radius around your crosshair (in degrees) in which a target starts to slow your mouse.
aimslowplus.option.min_multiplier.toolti: The mouse never goes below this share of your normal sensitivity, so it can't freeze.
aimslowplus.option.range.tooltip: Targets farther than this many blocks are ignored.
aimslowplus.option.activation.tooltip: How gradually the slowdown engages. Higher = softer. Instant = no smoothing.
aimslowplus.option.release.tooltip: How gradually normal sensitivity comes back. Higher = softer. Instant = no smoothing.
aimslowplus.option.players_only.tooltip: Only other players slow your mouse. Mobs and animals are ignored.
aimslowplus.option.ignore_teammates.tool: Players/entities on your scoreboard team never slow your mouse.
aimslowplus.option.line_of_sight.tooltip: Targets hidden behind blocks are ignored.
